rows.label: Batman
rows.hook: is a masked vigilante who protects Gotham City after witnessing his parents' murder

rows.label: Sherlock Holmes
rows.description: fictional character (consulting detective) created by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle
rows.hook: is a deerstalker-wearing London detective famous for brilliant deductions and a pipe

rows.label: Bugs Bunny
rows.hook: is a wisecracking cartoon rabbit who munches carrots and asks "What's up, Doc?"

rows.label: Captain America
rows.hook: is a super-soldier with a vibranium shield, frozen in ice and revived in the modern day

rows.label: Pikachu
rows.description: Pokémon species, mascot of the Pokémon franchise
rows.hook: is a yellow electric mouse with red cheeks and a lightning-bolt tail, the face of a monster-catching franchise

rows.label: Mario
rows.description: fictional character in the Mario video game franchise
rows.hook: is a mustachioed plumber in red who jumps on turtles and rescues a princess

rows.label: SpongeBob SquarePants
rows.description: main character from the animated television show SpongeBob SquarePants
rows.hook: is a cheerful yellow sea sponge who lives in a pineapple under the sea and flips burgers

rows.label: Stitch
rows.description: fictional extraterrestrial character from Disney's Lilo & Stitch franchise
rows.hook: is a blue alien experiment who causes chaos while learning the meaning of family

rows.label: Daffy Duck
rows.hook: is a black, lisping, hot-tempered Looney Tunes waterfowl who loves treasure and shouts "You're desthpicable!"

rows.label: Tweety
rows.hook: is a tiny yellow canary who famously says "I tawt I taw a puddy tat"

rows.label: Robin
rows.hook: is the teenage sidekick in a colorful costume who fights crime alongside a caped hero

rows.label: Sonic the Hedgehog
rows.description: video game character from the eponymous video game franchise
rows.hook: is a speedy blue video game mascot who collects golden rings

rows.label: Bucky Barnes
rows.hook: is a sidekick turned brainwashed assassin with a metal arm

rows.label: Ash Ketchum
rows.hook: is a ten-year-old trainer in a red cap who dreams of becoming a Pokémon Master

rows.label: Mike Wazowski
rows.hook: is a green one-eyed monster who works at a scream-powered factory and has a round, comic personality

rows.label: Buzz Lightyear
rows.hook: is a space ranger action figure who flies "to infinity and beyond"

rows.label: Scooby-Doo
rows.hook: is a cowardly Great Dane who solves spooky mysteries and loves snacks

rows.label: Patrick Star
rows.hook: is a dim-witted pink starfish who lives under a rock in Bikini Bottom

rows.label: Kermit the Frog
rows.hook: is a green puppet who sings about how it's not easy being green

rows.label: Rick Sanchez
rows.description: main version (C-137) of Rick in Rick and Morty
rows.hook: is a burping mad scientist who drags his grandson on interdimensional adventures

rows.label: Sylvester
rows.description: fictional anthropomorphic cat in the Looney Tunes and Merrie Melodies series of cartoons
rows.hook: is a tuxedo-patterned cartoon cat who lisps and is forever trying to eat a small bird

rows.label: Frodo Baggins
rows.description: fictional character from J.R.R. Tolkien's legendarium
rows.hook: is a hobbit tasked with carrying a powerful ring to a fiery mountain

rows.label: Woody
rows.description: fictional toy cowboy character from Disney and Pixar's Toy Story franchise
rows.hook: is a pull-string toy sheriff who is a child's favorite plaything

rows.label: Dana Scully
rows.description: fictional character and protagonist of the television series The X-Files
rows.hook: is a skeptical medical doctor and FBI agent who investigates unexplained cases

rows.label: Ratchet
rows.description: fictional medic of the Transformers franchise.

rows.label: Shrek
rows.hook: is a grumpy green ogre who loves his swamp and rescues a princess

rows.label: Miss Piggy
rows.hook: is a glamorous diva puppet pig with a karate chop and a flair for drama

rows.label: Han Solo
rows.hook: is a smuggler who pilots the Millennium Falcon and shoots first

rows.label: Dorothy Gale
rows.description: fictional protagonist of many of the Oz novels by the American author L. Frank Baum
rows.hook: is a Kansas farm girl swept away by a tornado who follows the yellow brick road

rows.label: Luigi
rows.description: fictional video game character from the Mario franchise
rows.hook: is a taller, green-clad plumber who often lives in his brother's shadow

rows.label: Fox Mulder
rows.description: fictional character and protagonist of the television series The X-Files
rows.hook: is an FBI agent obsessed with aliens and a poster reading "I Want to Believe"

rows.label: Donkey
rows.hook: is a talkative, wisecracking pack animal who becomes a loyal companion to a swamp-dweller

rows.label: Fred Flintstone
rows.hook: is a caveman who works at a quarry and yells "Yabba Dabba Doo!"
